key_concepts: Different types of weather include sunny, rainy, cloudy, and windy
People should take safety precautions during different weather types
Weather phenomena can have both positive and negative impacts
Studying weather is important for daily life in the Philippines
Basic weather characteristics include air temperature, air pressure, wind speed, wind dire
Weather reports describe current conditions using these characteristics
Weather patterns vary by area in the Philippines
Weather types can be named in English and Filipino
